title: seed1879 L2-core/L3-support route formation trajectory
status: frozen longitudinal causal tomography on a new shared panel
hypothesis: The L2-core/L3-support route is established by the end of 16-chunk curriculum training and remains stable through Probe withdrawal and zero-Probe maintenance.

checkpoint_signature_rules.whole_memory_causal: formed behavior and reset-all, zero-all, and batch-roll-all query <=0.20
checkpoint_signature_rules.L2_core: whole-Memory causal; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.80; zero-L3 >=0.80; keep-L3 <=0.20; keep-L2-L3 >=0.90
checkpoint_signature_rules.L3_support: keep-L2-L3 minus keep-L2 >=0.03 and intact minus roll-L3 >=0.05
checkpoint_signature_rules.L3_core: whole-Memory causal; zero-L3 and roll-L3 <=0.20; keep-L3 >=0.80; zero-L2 >=0.80; keep-L2 <=0.20

registered_trajectory_classification.l2_core_l3_support_established_by_16chun: curriculum_16 and all six later checkpoints are l2_core_l3_supported
registered_trajectory_classification.l2_core_l3_support_emerges_during_withdr: curriculum_16 is not l2_core_l3_supported and zero_0450/0600/0750 all are
registered_trajectory_classification.post_curriculum_route_destabilization: curriculum_16 is l2_core_l3_supported but one or more of zero_0450/0600/0750 are not
registered_trajectory_classification.post_curriculum_route_migration_observed: at least two different formed whole-Memory-causal route classes occur from curriculum_16 onward and no earlier rule applies

secondary_outputs: L2 necessity, L3 contribution, and pair-recovery effect curves
scope: This is a within-seed retrospective causal trajectory. It can locate route emergence along seed1879's saved path but cannot estimate route prevalence or prospective formation reliability across initialization.
stop_rule: Report the fixed trajectory and classification; do not select a preferred checkpoint, add intermediate checkpoints, or retrain after observing results.
